The story has a girl with a freshly casted broken arm conclude from the callus that the arm can bear load, test it by blocking thrown balls despite pain, and plan to act as a gymnastics base days later, presented as fine. Fractures need immobilization; callus only shows on X-ray within about 6 weeks and bone is about 80% strength at 3 months (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bone_fracture).

The story names $3 as the equilibrium/market-clearing price, yet comics remained unsold at $3 and only cleared at $2. By definition the market-clearing price is where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied with nothing left over (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supply_and_demand), so the worked example misidentifies it.
